title: Machine translation (tr.<lang>.json)
description: Shown next to the original as a reference only. build.py checks that each node translation keeps exactly the [label] holes of its children, and that line and paragraph counts match.

nodes.description: Node label -> translation of its own wording, with [label] holes for its children.

lines.description: Claim number -> one translated line per line of the claim body.

summary.description: Summary role (problem, solution, effect) -> [heading, paragraph, ...] in the same order as the source file.
